hero.description: We are Bros404. An attempt by two friends to save the world (or at least make it a bit more fun). We design modern, fast, and user-friendly applications.

whatWeDo.subtitle: Our Story
whatWeDo.desc_1: Actually, it all started with the sentence 'Wouldn't it be nice if we made an app'. As two friends, while chasing big ideas to change the world, we found ourselves developing fun and useful mobile applications.
whatWeDo.desc_2: Our goal at Bros404 is simple: to produce work that puts a smile on people's faces and makes technology enjoyable rather than complicated. We are also bored of dull corporate sites and incomprehensible menus.
whatWeDo.feature_1_desc: It's not enough that it just works, it should be read like poetry.
whatWeDo.feature_2_desc: Interactive interfaces that don't bore the user.
whatWeDo.feature_3_desc: The shortest and most effective path from idea to product.

work.title: What Have We Done?
work.subtitle: For now, the star of our showcase is here. New ones will be added soon.
work.app_desc: Nail fashion is now at your fingertips. Design the nails of your dreams, see instantly how they look on your own hand with AI. Thousands of color combinations, trending models and care tips.
work.strong_desc: Nail fashion is now at your fingertips.

about.title: Who Are We?
about.subtitle: The brains behind Bros404. (Or at least we think so.)
about.ulvi_bio: The code machine who grabs the corner socket of the cafe table and never leaves his black terminal. Talks in database queries, draws API architectures during coffee breaks. The backend architect who builds the brain of the system, always saying 'We can write this more optimized'.
about.mert_bio: At the other end of the cafe table, the engineer who writes both the code and builds the logic of the UI. Translating complex designs into clean code, structuring the user experience with algorithmic precision. The architect of code that appeals to both the eye and the mind.

contact.title: Let's Meet!
contact.subtitle: Got a new project? Or just want to say hi? Fill out the form, and we'll get back to you ASAP. We promise you won't fall onto a 404 page.
contact.form_msg_ph: What would you like to tell us?

nailiyPage.title: Nailiy
nailiyPage.subtitle: Nail Design Studio
nailiyPage.description: Turn your dream nail designs into reality with AI. Discover elegance at your fingertips and instantly see thousands of color combinations on your own hand.
nailiyPage.feature_1_desc: Upload a photo of your hand and instantly see models applied to your fingers.
nailiyPage.feature_2_desc: Create your own style with an unlimited color palette and accessories.
nailiyPage.feature_3_desc: Get inspired by other designers' posts and catch the trends.
nailiyPage.upcoming_subtitle: The social media of the beauty world: We are arriving with brand new features!
nailiyPage.upcoming_1_desc: Easily book appointments at your favorite beauty salons.
nailiyPage.upcoming_2_desc: See the latest designs and procedures shared by salons.
nailiyPage.upcoming_3_desc: Get in touch directly with salons and experts.
nailiyPage.upcoming_4_desc: Review salon employees and book appointments with the expert you want.
nailiyPage.upcoming_5_desc: See all services, prices, and details offered by salons.
nailiyPage.upcoming_6_desc: Rate salons and read the experiences of others.
nailiyPage.download_subtitle: Download for free now from the App Store to catch the trends!
